Step 4: Upload It to Stan Store or Systeme.io Set up automatic delivery so customers receive the product instantly after purchase—no manual work required. Step 5: Promote It with Faceless Reels Create simple text-based videos, screen recordings, or tutorials. No need to show your face or record yourself talking. Step 6: Automate the Sales Process Set up an automated response so when someone comments on your post, they instantly receive the link. More engagement, more sales, less effort.
